overall_verdict.summary: Paper 32 v1.5 carried stale CMB-prediction and R4/P4 compression language. v2.0 repairs this by treating optical R4 as FIRAS-fixed by Paper 17 v1.5 and preserving KB7/P4 only on the active reduced scalar source block.

kappa_candidates.rigidity_test: Replace R4 by arbitrary positive kappa_R4 in T_obs=T_IO*x^(kappa_R4*K_gauge). Paper 32 KB7 does not constrain it; modular/gauge algebra permits the family.
kappa_candidates.classification: FIRAS-FIXED / CONDITIONAL_VERIFIED on FIRAS empirical thermal datum
kappa_candidates.recommendation: Use R4_FIRAS=1.0031014644105183; do not call observed CMB an independent IO prediction.

kappa_candidates.rigidity_test: Replace Z(s)=s^(K_gauge/x) by arbitrary character. KB7/P4 source-class lock forces Z(e^x)=Q only on the active reduced scalar source block.
kappa_candidates.recommendation: Keep Paper 32 KB7 result but explicitly say it is not optical R4.

kappa_candidates.rigidity_test: Replace ln(1+gamma_BI^2) by another scalar. Gauge-side determinant/Barbero-Immirzi bridge fixes Q and K_gauge.
Treat FIRAS temperature as predicted output after using it to fix R4; this is circular.
kappa_candidates.recommendation: Remove prediction language and call it FIRAS-fixed readout normalization.

kappa_candidates.rigidity_test: Insert optical R4 into n_s=1-K_gauge/x. The source-block derivation uses K_gauge/x, not optical thermal R4.
Insert optical R4 into the lowest-shell Hawking amplitude formula. No optical temperature normalization enters.
Insert optical R4 into Delta=x^4 Q and x_crit=Q^(-1/4). No temperature readout enters.
Insert optical R4 into OS acceleration or time equations. The equations use r_s, c, and bounce/restart packages only.
